text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Meisho Doto-san. Please read 
aloud starting from page 36 of your 
textbook.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um... "This year's Enka Fest was brought 
to an unprecedented halt when the 
headliner threw out their—" ...Mmph!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-T-This isn't my textbook!? Wahhhh, I'm 
s-s-so sorry!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Are these playscripts from Opera O-san?! 
Th-there isn't... a single textbook 
here...?!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm so sorry~~! I forgot 
completelyyy~~!!

After spending the entire day sharing a 
textbook with the person sitting next to 
her, Meisho Doto was thoroughly 
remorseful...
